===The [[Bourse]]===
Under normal circumstances, all White Granite Bourse Seats would have been re-elected or re-appointed during the Solstice. Due to concerns of economic stability in a time of Imperial crisis, the seats gained at the Winter Equinox 376 will run until the Winter Equinox 377 and then the normal process of re-election will begin again.<br>
